overall_notes: Most legs clear break-even on paper, but stale WinDaily pairs and single-book NBA holds mean true edges are thinner than est_prob. I would cut Dak over (red-zone target loss) and Jabari under (usage spike), and I am wary of Michael Penix under given a slim margin and sloppy injury context in the write-up.

votes.reasoning: Two-way devig at the exact 1.5 line and a 6/9 game pattern of ≤1 TD align with a meaningful edge even after haircutting stale prices. Trailing as an 8.5-point home dog adds attempt volume risk, but this offense has not converted drives into scores and the market still prices under strongly. I would cut if Wilson or the receiving corps were unexpectedly limited or wind at MetLife turned high.

The devig is at the correct 1.5, but only 4/9 games hit 2+ TDs while the drafter admits the market outruns the hit rate. Jake Ferguson out removes a primary red-zone target for Dak, which directly undercuts a pass-TD over thesis indoors. I would keep only if practice reports showed another WR/TE absorbing clear RZ role or the pick’em line dropped to 0.5–1.0.

Low-hold two-way devig at 1.5 and an early-down role with 0 catches in the last two games support under despite a solid-looking probability. Nacua and Adams on IR create checkdown redistribution risk, but recent target volume on Corum has still been minimal. I would cut if he clearly gains passing-down snaps or the app line is 0.5 instead of 1.5.

≤2 receptions in 6/9, JSN ahead in pecking order, Drew Lock starting for Darnold, and a 6.5-point favorite script favoring run volume all support under at 2.5. The edge is modest after stale-price and hold adjustment, so this is more a portfolio leg than a slam dunk. Lock playing sharper than expected or Kupp’s route share jumping would push me to cut.

Lawrence at 2+ TDs in 5/8 with weakened TEN linebacker corps gives a plausible path to two scores without needing a shootout. A large favorite spread does create some late run-the-clock risk, but touchdowns often come in the first half when JAX should still be aggressive. I would cut if key JAX receivers were out or the spread tightened materially pre-kick.

58.2% est_prob is only a sliver above power-play break-even once you trim for stale best-price pairing, and Penix has multiple 3-TD games in a small sample. The write-up also misattributes Kenneth Walker to KC, which signals loose injury review on a borderline leg. Bijan-centric offense helps under, but I would not trust this leg in a 5-leg entry without a fatter market margin.

Trend of ≤2 made threes in 6/10 on roughly 6.5 attempts supports under at 2.5, and back-to-back fatigue is a mild plus for lower shooting volume. Single-book FanDuel devig with ~7% hold likely overstates true under probability versus a multi-book pair. Scottie Barnes questionable is a minor usage-variance risk but not enough alone to cut.

Recent five-game ≤2 three-point make streak is attractive, but VanVleet out, Smart suspended, and Capela out all raise Smith’s minutes and shot opportunity against a weak Washington defense. The drafter already flags this, and the same single-book FanDuel pair likely inflates edge much like L7. I would keep only if starting lineup news showed no meaningful usage bump or the line moved to 3.5.
